title: Home
description: Current alerts, platform and service health, and machines across the homelab.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing now, apart from the always-on Watchdog. The duration counts from when the condition first held.

panels.title: Kubernetes
panels.description: Healthy: all three nodes ready and no failing pods, unready Flux resources or unhealthy Longhorn volumes.

panels.title: Proxmox

targets.expr: count((max by (id) (pve_up{job="pve-api",cluster="pve-sbx",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) == 0) and on (id) (max by (id) (pve_onboot_status{job="pve-api",cluster="pve-sbx"}) == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Healthy: quorum present, all three nodes online and every onboot guest running; duplicate API observations are reduced by guest or node ID.

panels.title: Sparks
panels.description: Healthy: both machines reporting; GPU warning at 87 °C gives three degrees of margin to the approximately 90 °C throttle point documented in docs/dgx-spark-thermal.md.

panels.title: Observability
panels.description: Healthy: no cluster scrape target down, logs arriving, and the alert pipeline working. "Working" means the always-on Watchdog alert is firing, which proves rules are evaluated; delivery is checked on the pipeline dashboard.

panels.title: Identity
panels.description: Kanidm ready replicas alongside desired replicas; the configured replica count is three.

panels.title: AI
panels.description: Healthy: inference is reachable and the Grafana MCP probe passed within the last ten minutes.

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: Current values per machine. Memory pressure is the share of time tasks stalled waiting for memory; a Spark with a model loaded keeps memory high without pressure. A machine stays listed for seven days after its last scrape.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job=~"node-exporter|(pve|spark)-node",platform!="",platform=~".*",instance=~".*",chip=~"nvme.*"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left node_hwmon_sensor_label{job=~"node-exporter|(pve|spark)-node",platform!="",platform=~".*",instance=~".*",chip=~"nvme.*",label="Composite"})
